summary: Native Android release 0.5.13 (versionCode 15): a version bump only, so mobile-release.yml publishes the phone side of agent PR reviewers (#206: the approval card lists the reviewers and the shown-draft hash covers them).

desktop.reason: Android version bump only; no desktop code changes.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo client ships over its own OTA lane; this bump touches only apps/android.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data changes in this bump; the features it ships carry their own manifests.

automated: mobile-release.yml runs the Android unit and lint gate and verifies package, signer fingerprint and checksum, and a version higher than the newest published APK when one exists (the monotonic check is skipped when no earlier APK asset is found), before it publishes.
notExercised: Installing the update on a physical device through the in-app updater.
